contentEn:
A whole house renovation in Vancouver, BC costs $150 to $450 per square foot in 2026, depending on the scope of work. A mid-range whole-home update — kitchen, two bathrooms, and flooring across a 1,500 sq ft home — typically runs $85,000 to $200,000. A full gut renovation with structural changes or a laneway home addition can reach $250,000 to $450,000 or more.

聚星装修 has completed whole house renovations across Vancouver neighbourhoods including Kerrisdale, Dunbar, Kitsilano, Marpole, and East Vancouver. Every cost figure below comes from a real completed project.

Real Vancouver Whole House Renovation Costs (2024–2026)

Project TypeScopeVancouver LocationActual Cost
Mid-range whole-home updateKitchen refresh, 2 bathroom renos, new flooring throughoutKerrisdale single-family (1,400 sqft)$118,000
Full kitchen + bathroom renoCustom cabinets, quartz counters, curbless shower, heated floorsKitsilano condo (980 sqft)$87,500
Whole-house renovation with suiteMain floor + basement suite creation, electrical upgrade to 200AEast Vancouver single-family (2,100 sqft)$224,000
Full gut + laneway additionStructural removal, new addition 400 sqft, laneway home connectionDunbar single-family (2,600 sqft total)$387,000

What Drives the Cost in Vancouver

1. Square Footage and Scope

The per-square-foot rule of thumb ($150–$450) scales with the scope of work. A cosmetic refresh — new paint, flooring, and fixtures — sits at the lower end. Structural changes, layout reconfiguration, and mechanical upgrades push costs toward the higher end. Vancouver homes built before 1970 often require electrical panel upgrades (100A → 200A) at $3,000–$8,000, and may contain asbestos requiring abatement at $2,000–$15,000 before demolition.

2. Permits and the City of Vancouver

The City of Vancouver charges building permit fees at approximately 1% of the construction value for most renovations, plus Development Cost Levies (DCLs) for any new floor area. Laneway homes and secondary suites trigger additional DCLs ($3,000–$8,000 per unit). Heritage-register properties or pre-1940 homes require heritage review before permits issue — adding 4 to 8 weeks and potentially significant compliance costs.

3. Strata and Condo Requirements

roughly 45% of Vancouver residential properties are strata-titled (condos and townhouses in Kitsilano, Yaletown, Olympic Village, and most of the West Side). Strata renovation approval requires a formal vote and may limit work hours, material delivery access, and noise-generating activities. Budget an additional $2,000–$6,000 for strata management fees, legal review, and approval process costs.

4. Site Conditions — Narrow Lots and Shared Walls

Vancouver's distinctive narrow-lot streets (often 25–33 ft wide) create access constraints for material delivery and scaffolding. Semi-detached homes and row houses share wall structures, requiring coordination with neighbours and additional engineering assessments ($1,500–$4,000). These conditions add 10–15% to typical costs compared to detached single-family homes on standard lots.

Vancouver Whole House Renovation Cost by Scope

Kitchen + Two Bathrooms + Flooring (Most Common Package)

This is the most common Vancouver whole-house scope — a complete kitchen renovation, two bathroom renovations, and full-flooring replacement. It does not require structural permits in most cases.

ItemTypical Cost RangeNotes
Kitchen renovation (custom cabinets, quartz, layout change)$38,000–$75,000Varies most by cabinet scope
Primary bathroom (full gut, curbless, heated floors)$22,000–$45,000Plumbing relocation adds $3,000–$8,000
Second bathroom (standard renovation)$14,000–$28,000Already-equipped second bath costs less
Full-flooring replacement (hardwood or LVP throughout)$9,000–$22,0001,400 sqft home; material grade dependent
Painting (whole house)$3,500–$7,000Including ceilings and trim
Electrical panel upgrade (100A → 200A)$3,000–$8,000Required for many Vancouver pre-1970 homes
Permits and inspections$2,500–$6,000Based on construction value

Total typical package: $92,000–$191,000 for a 1,400 sq ft Vancouver home, excluding site-specific conditions like asbestos or heritage review.

Full Gut Renovation ($250,000–$450,000+)

A full gut renovation — stripping the home to its framing, rewiring, repiping, adding or moving walls, and rebuilding — applies to homes where the existing layout is fundamentally inadequate or where significant additions are planned. This scope always requires structural engineering and full building permits. Budget 18 to 36 months from design to move-in for this scope level.
contentZh:
温哥华（Vancouver, BC）整屋装修在 2026 年的造价为每平方英尺 $150 至 $450，实际费用取决于工程范围。中档全屋翻新（厨房、两间浴室、全屋地板，房屋面积 1,400 平方英尺）通常在 $85,000 至 $200,000 之间。若涉及结构改动或加建，全面拆旧翻新造价可达 $250,000 至 $450,000 甚至更高。

聚星装修（Reno Stars）在温哥华 Kerrisdale、Dunbar、Kitsilano、Marpole 及温东均有完工项目。以下所有费用数据均来自 2024–2026 年真实完工项目。

温哥华整屋装修真实费用（2024–2026 年项目记录）

项目类型工程范围温哥华区域实际费用
中档全屋翻新厨房更新、2 间浴室翻新、全屋地板更换Kerrisdale 独立屋（1,400 平方英尺）$118,000
厨房 + 浴室全面翻新定制橱柜、石英石台面、无槛淋浴、加热地板Kitsilano 公寓（980 平方英尺）$87,500
含套房改造的全屋翻新主层 + 地下室套房新建、电路升级至 200A温东独立屋（2,100 平方英尺）$224,000
全面拆旧 + 后巷房加建结构拆除、新建 400 平方英尺、后巷房接入Dunbar 独立屋（总建面 2,600 平方英尺）$387,000

影响温哥华装修费用的关键因素

1. 房屋面积与工程范围

每平方英尺 $150–$450 的造价规律随工程范围变化。表面翻新（油漆、地板、灯具）造价最低。结构改动、布局调整和机电升级推高费用。1970 年前建造的温哥华房屋常需电箱升级（100A → 200A），费用 $3,000–$8,000；可能含石棉，需额外 $2,000–$15,000 清除处理。

2. 许可证与温哥华市政府

温哥华市对大多数装修项目收取工程总价约 1% 的建筑许可证费用，并针对任何新增建筑面积收取发展成本费（DCL）。后巷房和套房项目触发额外 DCL（每单元 $3,000–$8,000）。列入遗产名录或 1940 年前建成的物业在发放许可证前需进行遗产审查——可能增加 4 至 8 周审批时间及相应合规成本。

3. Strata 和公寓相关规定

温哥华约 45% 的住宅为 strata 产权（Kitsilano、Yaletown、Olympic Village 及西侧大多数公寓和联排别墅）。Strata 翻新审批需经正式投票，并可能限制施工时间、材料进场和噪音作业。预算额外 $2,000–$6,000 用于 strata 管理费、法律审查和审批流程。

4. 现场条件——窄地块与共用墙

温哥华独特的窄地块（通常宽 25–33 英尺）给材料进场和脚手架搭建带来限制。半独立屋和排屋共用墙体结构，需与邻居协调并可能增加工程评估费用（$1,500–$4,000）。这些条件相较于标准地块的独立屋增加约 10–15% 的成本。

温哥华全屋装修费用——按工程范围

厨房 + 两间浴室 + 地板（最常见套餐）

这是温哥华最常见的全屋装修套餐——完整厨房翻新、两间浴室翻新、全屋地板更换。通常不需要结构许可证。

项目常规费用范围备注
厨房翻新（定制橱柜、石英石台面、布局改动）$38,000–$75,000橱柜范围影响最大
主卫（全面拆旧、无槛淋浴、加热地板）$22,000–$45,000水管移位额外 $3,000–$8,000
次卫（标准翻新）$14,000–$28,000已有基础设施的次卫费用较低
全屋地板更换（实木或 LVP）$9,000–$22,0001,400 平方英尺；材料等级决定费用
全屋油漆$3,500–$7,000含天花板和线条
电箱升级（100A → 200A）$3,000–$8,0001970 年前建成房屋常见需求
许可证与检查$2,500–$6,000按工程总价计算

典型套餐总计：$92,000–$191,000（温哥华 1,400 平方英尺房屋，不含石棉清除或遗产审查等特殊现场情况）。

全面拆旧翻新（$250,000–$450,000+）

全面拆旧翻新——将房屋剥至框架、重新布线、重铺管道、增减墙体、整体重建——适用于现有布局根本不适合需求或计划进行大规模加建的房屋。此范围始终需要结构工程设计和完整建筑许可证。从设计到入住，此范围预算 18 至 36 个月。
